name: Zen Mandalas
description: Twelve detailed mandalas for grown-ups to color: rings of lotus petals, ferns, cherry blossom, ginkgo, peonies, roses, tropical leaves, wildflowers, dahlias, irises, poppies, and lavender with olive, with finer areas and lighter outlines than the children's packs.
style: Adult coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a clear empty white margin on all sides; the design never touches the edges. One large circular mandala, centered, perfectly radially symmetric, filling about 90% of the page. Crisp black line art drawn with one medium line weight everywhere, never hairline. Every shape is fully closed so it can be filled. Intricate but clean: many concentric rings of petals, leaves and bands, with no shape smaller than about 2% of the page width. No shading, no grey, no stippling, no dots, no hatching, no solid black fills, no text, no border frame, nothing outside the mandala.

pages.name: Lotus Bloom
pages.subject: a lotus flower seen from above at the center, circled by three rings of pointed lotus petals, a ring of round lily pads and an outer ring of layered lotus petals

pages.name: Fern Spiral
pages.subject: a small daisy at the center with sixteen curling fern fronds radiating outward like a pinwheel, each frond split into separate leaflets, with a scalloped band between them

pages.name: Cherry Blossom
pages.subject: a ring of five-petal cherry blossoms around a central blossom, with small almond leaves between the flowers and an outer ring of alternating blossoms and buds

pages.name: Ginkgo Wheel
pages.subject: fan-shaped ginkgo leaves with veined sections arranged in two concentric rings around a circle of teardrop petals, with a wavy band between the rings

pages.name: Peony Medallion
pages.subject: a large layered peony at the center with ruffled petals in several rows, surrounded by a ring of peony leaves and an outer ring of small peony buds and scallops

pages.name: Rose Window
pages.subject: a spiral rose at the center, a ring of eight smaller roses with serrated rose leaves between them, and an outer band of heart-shaped petals like a cathedral rose window

pages.name: Tropical Leaves
pages.subject: a hibiscus flower at the center, surrounded by eight monstera leaves with their holes and splits, and an outer ring of long split palm leaflets

pages.name: Wildflower Ring
pages.subject: a sunflower center with seed-like segments, a ring of cosmos flowers, a ring of pointed willow leaves and an outer ring of bell-shaped wildflowers and tulips

pages.name: Dahlia Burst
pages.subject: a large pompom dahlia at the center made of many rows of rounded tube-shaped petals, surrounded by a ring of pointed dahlia petals and an outer ring of small dahlias alternating with oval leaves

pages.name: Iris Crown
pages.subject: a small star-shaped flower at the center, circled by eight iris blooms with three upright petals and three falling petals each, long sword-shaped iris leaves between them and an outer scalloped band

pages.name: Poppy Circle
pages.subject: a poppy seed head with a ribbed star-shaped cap at the center, a ring of wide crinkled poppy petals, a ring of feathery poppy leaves and an outer ring of poppy buds and open poppies

pages.name: Lavender & Olive
pages.subject: a rosette of rounded petals at the center, eight bold lavender sprigs radiating outward, each sprig a thick stem lined with large separate teardrop-shaped buds, a wide olive branch between each pair of sprigs with broad outlined leaves and big oval olives, a ring of rounded scallops filling the space between the branches, and an outer braided band
